# databus-app

> Ionic Vue 8 + Capacitor 8 operator/on-board client for the **Databús** transit
> system (UCR/SIMOVI). It is a REST UI ("warm path": login, start/end run,
> lifecycle) **and** an MQTT GPS telemetry publisher ("hot path"). It has **no
> backend of its own** — all server behavior lives in sibling repos.

## Orientation (read these first)

- [README.md](./README.md): full architecture, how it works, dev/prod, testing, TODO.
- [DATABUS_INTEGRATION.md](./DATABUS_INTEGRATION.md): backend contract + prioritized "asks for the databus team". Hand this to a databus agent.
- [SITEMAP.md](./SITEMAP.md): navigation/screen spec (Spanish).
- [plans/master-plan.md](./plans/master-plan.md): authoritative build spec; §6 = frozen contracts (store/service signatures, telemetry seam, MQTT payload).

## Sibling repos (server side — this app is one client of it)

- `../databus` — Django/DRF orchestrator (`:8000` dev / 443 TLS prod), NanoMQ broker (1883 dev / 8883 TLS prod), Redis, Celery, the run-lifecycle FSM. **Every backend fact is verified here** — key files: `backend/api/{urls,views,serializers}.py`, `backend/runs/domain/lifecycle/{transitions,guards,events,actions}.py`.
- `../databus-sim` — fleet simulator that drives runs to completion via GTFS-RT telemetry. **Use it to test the full lifecycle** (browser alone can't advance a run past Confirmed).
- `../context` — system docs.

## Where things are (all under `app/`)

- `src/views/` — one page per screen: Splash, Login, Home, Runs, Messages, User, Tabs.
- `src/components/trips/` — `TripSetupModal.vue` (run wizard), `RunProgress.vue`.
- `src/components/runs/` — `RunHistoryList.vue`, `RunDetailsModal.vue`.
- `src/components/user/` — `ProfileEditModal.vue`. `src/components/ui/` — AppError, AppLoading, EmptyState, `BrandLogo.vue`.
- `src/stores/` (Pinia setup stores) — `auth.ts`, `run.ts` (owns telemetry + create/end + history recording), `runHistory.ts` (local log + `reconcile()`), `settings.ts` (device prefs + palette).
- `src/services/` — `apiClient.ts` (typed fetch, Token auth, ApiError), `schedule.ts` (GTFS/run REST lookups), `geolocation.ts`, `telemetry/` (the seam: `runtime.ts` + `webRuntime.ts` + `nativeRuntime.ts`).
- `src/services/pwa.ts` — service-worker registration. **Web only** — no-ops on native (same build feeds the Capacitor webview via `webDir: 'dist'`; a SW there strands the app on a stale precache).
- `src/theme/` — `variables.css`, `palettes.ts` (define palettes here), `applyPalette.ts` (derives Ionic vars at runtime).
- `src/types/` — `api.ts` (wire types), `domain.ts` (app types). `src/router/index.ts` — routes + auth guard.
- `plugins/capacitor-databus-telemetry/` — native TCP+TLS MQTT plugin (Kotlin + Swift): foreground service, background location, store-and-forward. Prod telemetry path.
- `public/logo/` — Databús wordmark (dark/light) + "b" mark (favicon/touch icon). `public/pwa/` — generated PWA icons (192, 512, maskable 512, apple-touch 180).
- `tests/unit/` (vitest), `tests/e2e/` (cypress).

## Critical domain facts (each was a real bug — don't relearn them)

- **A GTFS trip already carries `route_id` + `direction_id` + `shape_id`.** Run wizard is `route → trip → vehicle` (no "direction" step). Trips come from `GET /api/trips/?route_id=` — NOT the broken `which-shapes`/`find-trips`/`service-today` endpoints (they read empty tables: RouteStop/TripTime/CalendarDate).
- **Vehicle serializer omits `id`** (HyperlinkedModelSerializer emits `url` only). `schedule.getVehicles()` backfills `id` from the url tail.
- **Run lifecycle events**: confirm = `run_confirmed_by_operator`. Operator end = `run_interrupted` (from In Progress/No Signal) or `cancel_run` (earlier), each with `details:{actor_role:"operator"}`. **`run_completed` is SYSTEM-only** (guard `is_at_terminal_stop`); the app must never send it (422s). The app records history on ANY observed terminal state — via manual end OR the ~5s poll — so system-completed runs still appear.
- **One active run per operator/vehicle/trip** — bound in Redis until terminal; a second create-run for a bound operator is rejected with a real message the app surfaces.
- **Telemetry is fire-and-forget**: `createRun` does NOT await `telemetry.start()` (broker unreachable in dev must not block/trap the modal). Health shows via `telemetry.status`.
- **Store rehydration happens in `main.ts` BEFORE `app.use(router)`** so the auth guard doesn't bounce a refresh to /login. Native has no refresh; same path runs on cold start (Preferences = OS storage).
- **MQTT contract**: topic `transit/vehicle/<vehicle_id>/position`, QoS 0, payload `{latitude,longitude,bearing?,speed?,timestamp?}`.
- **The PWA is a test/demo vehicle for the warm path, never a telemetry path.** A browser has no background GPS (fixes stop on screen lock) and prod exposes no WS listener. `VITE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false` (set in `.env.production`) makes the web runtime report `status='unavailable'` and skip the publisher + GPS watcher. Without it the runtime sits in **`'buffering'`**, which *promises store-and-forward* ("held locally, flushed on reconnect") against a broker that does not exist — a lie to the operator. Only the literal string `'false'` disables; unset keeps the loud throw on a missing `VITE_MQTT_URL`. Native ignores the flag entirely.
- **The service worker must never touch `/api`.** The app is same-origin by design, so `workbox.navigateFallbackDenylist: [/^\/api/]` (vite.config.ts) is what stops Workbox answering API paths with `index.html`. There is **no** `runtimeCaching` for `/api` — deliberately: these are live run-lifecycle FSM reads, and a stale run state is worse than an error.
- **`registerType: 'prompt'`, never `'autoUpdate'`.** autoUpdate reloads the page when a new SW activates; the active run lives only in the Pinia run store (resume-on-boot is still open work), so that would silently drop an operator's run mid-trip. Updates land on the next cold start instead.

## Dev vs prod (important)

| | dev | prod |
|---|---|---|
| API | `http://localhost:8000` via **Vite proxy** at `/api` (sidesteps CORS — backend has no django-cors-headers) | `https://<host>` 443/TLS |
| Telemetry | MQTT over **WebSocket** (`ws://…:8083/mqtt`, mqtt.js) in browser | **raw MQTT TCP+TLS 8883** via native plugin (no WS listener in prod) |
| Runtime | `createWebRuntime` (browser GPS, in-mem queue) | `createNativeRuntime` (background loc, native buffer) |

The prod TCP+TLS path only runs on a native device build — it cannot be tested in a browser.

## Workflow

```bash
cd app
npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort   # strictPort avoids silent port drift
npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build   # all green: lint · 90 unit tests · build
```

- Demo login: `demo` / `demo12345` (seeded in `../databus`).
- **No PR to `main` without explicit user go-ahead.** Branch `feat/vertical-slice-v0` is 40 commits ahead of main; upstream tracking is configured so a bare `git push` works once the user has access.
- Env: `app/.env` — `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api`, `VITE_MQTT_URL=ws://localhost:8083/mqtt`.

## Open work (see README "What's left" + DATABUS_INTEGRATION "asks")

App: resume active run on boot (needs backend endpoint), Messages backend, Alerts (out of scope), native device validation, i18n wiring. Backend asks: operator current-run endpoint, run-list endpoint, cancel-from-Initialized transition, native broker TLS/auth config, CORS, VehicleSerializer `id`.
